epochs: E1 prior CE participation -> initial decision -> single realization
E2 authoritative post-outcome observation -> independent adverse evaluation -> Closure -> provenance-bound revalidation commit
E3 later relation -> later participation -> later decision -> single realization
adverse_outcome_rule: Only after initial worker output is sealed, authoritative observation impact_code == 'constraint_breach' is classified ADVERSE.
support_rule: Both causal links must hold: prior CE exposure changes the initial realized behavior and that exposed behavior is classified adverse only post-realization; then exposing the resulting decision-linked REVISED commit changes the later same-scope realized action to the preregistered recovery action relative to record-only. Exogenous evidence must not become decision-linked revision, and unrelated relations must not inherit the feedback.
invalidation_rules: wrongness/evaluator truth reaches initial decision worker
more than one realization per epoch
